_comment: Area classification for codebase_assessment_*.md (skill: codebase-assessment). First match wins, so narrow areas go first. Written 2026-09-04 because auto-detection put tools/*.html into `templates` (they are generated dev-tooling gallery pages, not app templates — an 8,310-line phantom +38%) and tools/*.py into `production` (tools/README.md: scripts that operate ON the repo but are not part of the app or its test suite). Amended 2026-09-30: the docs area excludes codebase_assessment_*.json sidecars, which are measurement output rather than documentation and had grown to 28,816 lines (16% of docs); the 22sep baseline was rebased the same way for that snapshot's deltas.
